movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Female dancers manipulate fans; male dancers carry a sword and shield.
movement_profile.footwork: Agile stepping in and out of bamboo poles.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers move between crisscrossed bamboo poles.
movement_profile.partnering: The prince and princess interact within the bamboo grid.

signature_moves.description: Graceful twirling of fans by the princess.
signature_moves.name: Fan manipulation

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies from slow to a climactic crescendo.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid performances that ignore the cultural context or violate traditional modesty norms.

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by the metallic, percussive clashing of bamboo poles and the resonance of the kulintang and agung gongs.

basic_steps: Step into the space between the bamboo poles when they are apart.
Step out of the space before the poles clap together.
Maintain a rhythmic pattern synchronized with the clashing poles.
teaching.formation: Two parallel rows of bamboo poles held by clappers, with dancers moving between them.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high agility and timing to avoid the moving bamboo poles.
teaching.rhythm: Syncopated rhythm created by the clashing bamboo.
